result.finding: Optional pgsql provider is included executable product code, not a platform-disabled template.

build/lib/execute.js:238-257 selects pgsql if config.name=iobroker and provider.enabled

result.finding: No default automatic pgsql execution is established. Shipped native pgSqlEnabled=false and host/name/user/password empty. New EOS enrollment disables adapter and all *Enabled flags. Existing modified installation settings are unknown.
evidence: runtime/bootstrap/own-adapter-enrollment.cjs:56-77; actual artifact SHA256 62bb185e00b1b82de200392870b9753bfc4fa42b2e570862fa000db5efd6f872; byte-identical to working tree

result.finding: pgsql restore dispatch is not protected by pgSqlEnabled. After licensed/operational readiness and archive acquisition, filename selects provider. Native platform guards reject iobroker/redis or isStop modules, while pgsql.isStop=false. Therefore optional licensed restore remains statically reachable. Runtime caller authorization and successful end-to-end invocation were not tested.

Legacy pgsql replay calls pg_dump rather than pg_restore and ignores create/replay errors, then can report successful restoration. This is a source-confirmed functional defect in the optional provider; no successful restore is claimed.

Optional backup and restore use shell command interpolation of configured connection values, including password in URI. Double-quote wrapping is not complete shell escaping. Potential command injection/argv secret exposure requires separate threat-boundary/runtime validation; no actual credential or demonstrated exploit was found in this focused review.

Normal logical EOS controller backup is a separate path: 10-iobroker forks controller CLI backup. Actual archive CLI files match private staging/archive transform hashes. This does not prove PostgreSQL physical/system restoration.

Literal iobroker:iobroker URI appears only in an explanatory comment; operative command uses configuration. Shipped pgSqlPassword is empty. This literal is not evidence of a bundled active operator credential.

existingDocumentation: system/integration/backitup-observations.json contains historical open legacy-secret and restore privilege findings NW-EOS-INT-BAK-004/-005, against earlier source; it is not proof of current reachability or closure.
components/backitup/reports/startup-20261015/README_DE.md explicitly leaves native PostgreSQL/system recovery and file-server session security open.
